# Portfolio project instructions

This repository contains a modern React + Vite portfolio site. Keep the experience premium, fast, and mobile-friendly.

This project includes reusable agent skills for frontend design and UX polish:
- `frontend-design`
- `ui-ux-pro-max`
- `impeccable`
- `branding-voice`
- `seo-ux`
- `accessibility-audit`
- `performance-optimization`
- `speckit`
- `brainstorming`
- `figma-to-code`
- `content-strategy`
- `browser-qa`
- `portfolio-launch-readiness`

## Project goals
- Use accessible semantic HTML and meaningful text content.
- Prefer responsive layouts with strong spacing and contrast.
- Keep dependencies lean; favor CSS and components over unnecessary libraries.
- Preserve a polished, modern aesthetic with subtle gradients, glassmorphism, and motion.

## Coding conventions
- Use functional React components and descriptive prop/data names.
- Keep styles co-located in `src/App.css` and global resets in `src/index.css`.
- Favor small, reusable UI patterns over duplicated markup.
- Validate the app with `npm run build` before finalizing large changes.

## Common commands
- `npm install` to install dependencies
- `npm run dev` to start the app
- `npm run build` to check the production build
